text: On 8 September 2026, the production page crashed on an attempt to approve a short that had been sent back for regeneration, a move the product's own rules do not allow. Since that fix, the approve, reject and regenerate buttons appear only on a short that is waiting for review, the one state in which such a decision is allowed. A useful question for any vendor is whether its screens can offer a choice that its own system will then refuse. Labels and buttons that match the real state of the work look like small details, yet they are what a person relies on when signing off.
